component_name: PART-001 F1 Front Wing Mounting Bracket
steps: 1. Set the envelope and section from the user's values: base leg 120 mm (X), width 70 mm (Y), support height 65 mm (Z), base 12 mm, upright 10 mm (R05-R09).
2. Set the inner bend fillet to the user minimum R5 (R12). Confirm it against DFM-MACH-INNER-RADIUS-MIN (>= 3 mm) and DFM-DFMEA-FATIGUE-FILLET (>= 0.2 x 12 = 2.4 mm).

3. Lay out the vehicle-side zone (A07): 2 x Ø10 holes in the base, 1 row x 2 columns symmetric about y=0. Keep them clear of the bend fillet and >= 1.5d (15 mm) from every free edge (GL-HOLE-EDGE-DISTANCE).
4. Lay out the front-wing zone (A07): 2 x Ø8 holes in the upright, 1 row x 2 columns, above the bend fillet run-out and >= 12 mm from the top and side edges.
5. Keep the generator origin (outer corner of the L, mid-width plane) as the local frame (R17). X, Y and Z follow R14-R16. The L-profile provides the orientation asymmetry (A08).
6. Select machined AL7075-T6 (A02, A03). Python runs the feasibility and DFM rule checks.
7. No load case was given (A04, A10). Register a zero-load placeholder so the structural hand calculation is reported NOT_RUN, not passed.
8. Place the component at (500, -250, 150) mm with roll/pitch/yaw 15/35/60 deg, using R = Rz*Ry*Rx (A09).
9. Build in Fusion. Measure the envelope, thicknesses, hole diameters and positions, fillet radius, and the placed pose read-back. Compare these with the expected geometry.

leg_base_length.rationale: Overall length along local X as given by the user.

leg_upright_height.rationale: Support height along local Z as given by the user (measured from z=0).

bracket_width.rationale: Overall width along local Y as given by the user.

bracket_thickness.rationale: Base thickness as given. 12 mm is far above the 2 mm machinable wall minimum.

upright_thickness.rationale: Vertical support thickness as given. Differs from the base, so the optional parameter is set explicitly.

bend_inner_radius.rationale: User minimum R5. Satisfies >= 3 mm end-mill access and >= 0.2 x 12 = 2.4 mm fatigue ratio. The outer fillet becomes 5 + 12 = 17 mm.

base_hole_diameter.rationale: User-specified Ø10 base mounting holes, treated as finished diameter (A05).

base_hole_rows.rationale: The 2 base holes are placed side by side in one row (1 x 2) to spread lateral moment about X across the 70 mm width.

base_hole_cols.rationale: Two columns symmetric about y=0 give the user's 2 base holes.

base_hole_x0.rationale: Centre is 50 mm past the fillet run-out (x = 10 + 5 = 15 mm), leaving tool and bolt-head access. It is 50 mm from the free end (x=120), well above 15 mm.

base_hole_pitch_x.rationale: Ignored with 1 row. If ever used, a second row at x=90 would still keep 30 mm to the free end.

base_hole_pitch_y.rationale: Centres at y=±20 sit 15 mm from the ±35 side edges (= 1.5 x 10, the maximum allowed spacing) and leave a 30 mm ligament between holes.

upright_hole_diameter.rationale: User-specified Ø8 front-wing mounting holes, treated as finished diameter (A05).

upright_hole_rows.rationale: One row of two holes keeps both holes in the free upright zone above the fillet.

upright_hole_cols.rationale: Two columns symmetric about y=0 give the user's 2 front-wing holes.

upright_hole_z0.rationale: Centre is roughly mid-way through the free upright zone (z = 12 + 5 = 17 to 65). It is 23 mm from the top edge (>= 12 mm) and 25 mm above the fillet run-out, leaving nut and washer clearance.

upright_hole_pitch_z.rationale: Ignored with 1 row. If ever used, a second row at z=52 would still be 13 mm from the top edge (>= 12 mm).

upright_hole_pitch_y.rationale: Centres at y=±20 sit 15 mm from the side edges (>= 1.5 x 8 = 12 mm). The pitch matches the base holes for a consistent interface pattern.

design_inputs.base_mates_with: vehicle/chassis-side front-wing mount (future F1 part; interface defined by base holes, A07)
design_inputs.upright_mates_with: front wing main plane / pylon (future F1 part; interface defined by upright holes, A07)

load_case.description: No load case defined by the user (M03/A04). This is a zero-force placeholder: the structural hand calculation must be reported NOT_RUN, not passed, until the user supplies force, direction, lever arm and safety factor.

new_assumptions.text: The load_case is a zero-force placeholder (force 0 N, lever arm 0 mm, safety factor 1.0 as a schema-required non-binding value). It is not a design load.
new_assumptions.rationale: The user gave no load (A04). Loads and safety factors must not be invented.
new_assumptions.impact: The structural check is NOT_RUN. Strength and stiffness remain unverified.

new_assumptions.text: Fastener sizes are left unspecified (design_inputs fasteners = null). Ø10 and Ø8 are not ISO 273 medium-series clearance values, so STD-ISO273-MEDIUM (advisory) may flag them. The user's diameters are kept.
new_assumptions.rationale: The user specified hole diameters, not bolts (A05). R03 makes them project-defined values.
new_assumptions.impact: Bolt size and fit class must be confirmed before mating with real parts. The advisory finding is expected and reported, not hidden.

placement.rationale: User-stated pose of the generator origin in the project frame. Roll/pitch/yaw are applied about X/Y/Z as R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) (A09).

verification_plan: Feasibility (Python): generator constraints pass for all parameters, including the hole layout clear of the bend fillet (base x0 = 70 > 15 mm; upright z0 = 42 > 17 mm).
Rule check DFM-MACH-WALL-MIN: min wall = min(12, 10) = 10 mm >= 2 mm.
Rule check DFM-MACH-INNER-RADIUS-MIN: inner bend R5 >= 3 mm.
Rule check GL-HOLE-EDGE-DISTANCE: base holes 15 mm to side edges and 50 mm to end (>= 15); upright holes 15 mm to sides and 23 mm to top (>= 12).
Rule check STD-ISO273-MEDIUM: expected advisory finding because no fastener is defined and Ø10/Ø8 do not match the medium series (A11). Report it as is.
Fusion measurement: bounding box 120 x 70 x 65 mm in the local frame; base 12 mm and upright 10 mm thickness; inner fillet R5 and outer R17; 4 holes with diameter and centre positions as planned.
Fusion placement read-back: occurrence transform equals translation (500, -250, 150) and R = Rz(60)·Ry(35)·Rx(15), checked fail-loud against the expected matrix.
Mass: computed from the measured volume x 2810 kg/m3 (AL7075-T6 has no Fusion material mapping), reported as indicative.
Structural hand calculation: NOT_RUN (no load case, A04/A10). No strength, safety or FIA compliance claim is made (A01, R02).
